'''Emlyn Mandel''' was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Kvarn Mandel]], head of [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. She lived on [[Thorgeld I]] in her [[Mandel family mansion|family's mansion]] with her husband and four children, including [[Samire Mandel|Samire]] and [[Simmin Mandel|Simmin]].
